assets.title: PowerDAG execution architecture
assets.authors: Emmanuel O. Badmus and Amritanshu Pandey
assets.paper: PowerDAG: Reliable Agentic AI System for Automating Distribution Grid Analysis
assets.changes: SVG reproduced unchanged; PNG is rasterization for the handout. Display on a white background. No scientific content altered.
assets.short_credit: Badmus & Pandey (2026), Fig. 2, CC BY-SA 4.0. Unchanged figure.
assets.teaching_point: The supervisor sits between proposed calls and the environment. Its prerequisite coverage is bounded; it is not an electrical safety certificate.
assets.adaptation_guidance: A labeled teaching redraw may highlight proposal, prerequisite check, execution and observation. License adapted figure CC BY-SA 4.0 and state changes. Do not omit the scope limit or claim its one-shot advisory is an absolute execution barrier.
assets.permission_basis: Reuse and adaptation under the linked Creative Commons license; author attribution and license retained.

assets.title: Grid-Agent roles and closed-loop workflow
assets.authors: Yan Zhang, Ahmad Mohammad Saber, Amr Youssef and Deepa Kundur
assets.paper: Grid-Agent: An LLM-Powered Multi-Agent System for Power Grid Control
assets.short_credit: Zhang et al. (2025), Grid-Agent v3, Fig. 1, CC BY 4.0. Unchanged.
assets.teaching_point: Separate topology, planning, execution, validation and reporting responsibilities. The tutorial uses its own five-stage proposal, not these exact role names.
assets.adaptation_guidance: Overlay highlights or redraw the role loop with attribution; label the tutorial mapping as a teaching adaptation. The published diagram does not establish learning gains for the tutorial SAC/selector.
assets.permission_basis: Reuse and adaptation under the linked Creative Commons license; author attribution and license retained.

assets.title: ReAct tool feedback examples
assets.authors: Shunyu Yao, Jeffrey Zhao, Dian Yu, Nan Du, Izhak Shafran, Karthik Narasimhan and Yuan Cao
assets.paper: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
assets.changes: SVG reproduced unchanged; PNG is rasterization for the handout.
assets.short_credit: Yao et al. (ICLR 2023), ReAct Fig. 1, CC BY 4.0. Unchanged figure.
assets.teaching_point: A tool observation can alter the next action. Published illustrative traces are not the tutorial Llama traces; show the latter as concise public rationales.
assets.adaptation_guidance: Use a brief source view, then an original teaching loop Request → Proposed tool → Observation → Updated request. Label this as a conceptual adaptation; do not copy the original sample as a grid experiment.
assets.permission_basis: Reuse and adaptation under the linked Creative Commons license; author attribution and license retained.
